text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Phalaenopsis 
staring intently at something on her desk.

There seem to be photographs laid out 
across the desk. 
Red, white, yellow, blue... 
So many pictures of various flowers.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, beautiful, aren't they? 
They were all gifted to me by fans.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Every so often, someone will send me 
photographs of flowers alongside a letter.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Here, just like this one.

Phalaenopsis handed me a letter. 
It appeared to be fan mail, reading as 
follows:

"The other day, a flower I've been 
nurturing finally bloomed. 
I took a lovely photo of it, so I am 
sending it to you."

"I hope it can bring even the slightest 
bit of 
peace and comfort to you, 
Phalaenopsis-san."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, such wonderful thoughtfulness, 
wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Arranging all these gifts from everyone 
like this, 
does it not resemble a flower bed?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Gazing upon these multicolored blossoms 
seems to bring such fullness to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If only they were right before me in 
person rather than in pictures— 
fufu, I even find myself dreaming of such 
things.
choice_data_list:
That sounds like a great idea! Why don't 
we do just that?

That sounds wonderful! Why don't we try 
it?

text_block_list.text:
And so—I accompanied Phalaenopsis 
to a park filled with blooming flowers.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this flower is...! 
It is identical to the one enclosed in 
that letter!
choice_data_list: Here's another one from the photos!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you speak the truth... I distinctly 
remember seeing this!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Such beautiful, fragrant blossoms... 
Each and every one of them is truly 
splendid.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To think everyone who wrote to me raised 
such 
gorgeous flowers to bloom. With their very 
own hands.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: How... profoundly precious.

From planting a seed until the bloom 
opens... 
Just how much time must it take, 
and how much devotion must it require?

Just imagining it sounds daunting— 
yet that is precisely why the flowers 
bloom so exquisitely.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, I must follow their example.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall surely make it bloom. 
The most beautiful flower of all—with 
these hands, and these legs!

Her resolve renewed, Phalaenopsis stood 
tall. 
Her eyes shone with a radiance that 
rivaled 
even the most brilliant of blossoms.
